summary: Iteration 141 (WEB-only): Backend 11/11 pass, Frontend all target flows verified. (A) Show Me How: sidebar nav-show-me-how opens the modal with all 4 guides (smh-guide-{research,meetings,memory,employees}) + smh-open-checklist. Memory guide: smh-prev disabled at step 0, smh-next advances through all steps, smh-goto on last step navigates to /ai-memory. (B) Setup Checklist: force-opened via smh-open-checklist -> nav to /dashboard, setup-checklist rendered with 7 rows for os@radciti.com. Done items (first_chat, started_research, saved_memory) show line-through and NO Go/Show me buttons; incomplete items show checklist-go-*, and 'compared_models'+'hosted_meeting' additionally show checklist-show-* (walkthrough-linked). complete=3, total=7 matches backend. checklist-toggle collapses items, checklist-dismiss hides card. (C) Role-Based Home persona reorder: after PATCH /api/user/onboarding {persona:'business'}, ASK look FeatureShortcuts order = ['chat','meeting','knowledge','tasks','documents','employees','memory','invite'] — EXACT match to persona.js business.featureOrder. FOCUS look identical order. StartCenter cards after the featured 'research' card = ['chat','meeting','project','knowledge','docs','task','employee','memory'] — EXACT match to business.cardOrder. (D) IntelligenceBanner present on all 4 looks (classic/start/ask/focus) with counts from /api/home/summary. (E) Regression: home-look-btn switcher works across all 4 variants; /my-ai no-param redirects to /chats/<personal_ai_id>. Backend: /api/home/summary and /api/home/checklist auth-gated (401 unauth), checklist returns 7 boolean items + complete+total=7. IMPORTANT DISCOVERY: the request spec says 'POST /api/auth/onboarding' but the actual route is PATCH /api/user/onboarding (also confirmed the wrong path returns 404). Also: PATCH /api/user/onboarding with {persona:null} returns 422 — cannot clear persona back to null via this endpoint (Pydantic model likely does not allow None).

minor.issue: Rejects {"persona": null} with 422 — no way to clear a user's persona back to unset via this route. If admin/user should be able to reset persona, OnboardingUpdate.persona should allow None. Not blocking new feature.

issues: Radix a11y warning: `DialogContent` requires a `DialogTitle` (visually-hidden acceptable). ShowMeHow.jsx renders headings as <h2> but no <DialogTitle>. Same pattern as NewTaskDialog flagged in iter139.

action_items: SPEC MISMATCH: main agent's own spec says POST /api/auth/onboarding but real route is PATCH /api/user/onboarding. Update task spec / any docs so future agents don't hit 404.
Allow PATCH /api/user/onboarding to accept {persona:null} (make OnboardingUpdate.persona Optional) so users/tests can clear persona back to default. Currently returns 422.
Wrap ShowMeHow's DialogContent with a (visually hidden) DialogTitle to fix the Radix a11y console warning.

Optional: SetupChecklist checklist-item-compared_models auto-ticks only when a research thread has >1 selected_models — verify this logic is what product wants (a user could 'compare' by opening two separate threads and never trip this).
critical_code_review_comments: persona.js CONFIGS has no `other` key even though the file comment says onboarding captures 'personal | student | team | business | enterprise | other'. `other` falls through to null → defaults. Either add an `other` config or update the comment to reflect that unknown/other = generic defaults.
SetupChecklist.jsx:11 uses NEW_WINDOW_MS=14 days but the product copy in the request says '7-day get more from TeamNest checklist'. Naming mismatch — either shorten window or rename copy.

SetupChecklist.jsx:65 `withinNewWindow` is only checked when NOT forced; that's correct, but a non-new user who clicks smh-open-checklist gets FORCE_KEY persisted -> forceOpen; the flag is then set to '0'. That means it only survives ONE navigation. Confirmed working, but if the user reloads /dashboard the checklist disappears again — main agent should confirm this is the intended UX.
ShowMeHow.jsx renders Dialog with no DialogTitle -> Radix a11y warning (repeat of iter139).

dashboard.py /home/checklist counts across the entire workspace for `saved_memory`, `uploaded_document` (workspace-scoped) but per-user for `first_chat`, `hosted_meeting`, `created_task`. That's the request's intent, but note: on a shared workspace, `saved_memory` will tick as soon as ANY teammate saves a memory item, not just the current user. Worth double-checking product intent.
